prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding interactive tips to the waiting screen (wait_info) was helpful and yielded a statistically significant gain (+5.0%).
Deferring sign-in (reorder), photo upload copy guidance (copy), and grid layout changes (layout) showed no clear effect.
Effect predictions were consistently too high across all tests, overestimating both positive gains and non-significant changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +5.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Controls Tutorial on Home Intro: Redesign the final home intro screen with an interactive checklist component teaching users how to control, drag, and hide their desktop pet. (why: Support emails show confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding (3 emails), and the finish step drops to 64.8%.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Time Estimate and Progress Counter on Choose Path: Display a explicit step counter and setup time estimate on the choose path screen so users know setup is fast. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s and conversion is 76.2%, suggesting drop-off due to unclear setup duration.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Warning Copy on Sign In: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly mention that signing in backs up pet customization and prevents loss. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing in again, making data backup messaging critical during sign_in.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Preview Screen Before Adoption Certificate: Insert a pet preview screen before the adoption certificate to allow users to verify their pet visual preview prior to finalizing adoption. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 60.9% adoption step conversion.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Alert Switch on Waiting Screen: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users are notified as soon as generation completes. (why: Mean duration on the waiting screen is 2336s (median 201s), indicating users switch away while waiting and forget to return.)
5: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Layout for Pick Friend: Redesign the pick friend screen to a split layout separating pet categories from detailed pet stats and preview. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s), showing friction during friend selection.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Placement Setup Screen: Add a new interactive desktop placement screen before home intro allowing users to choose initial desktop screen placement. (why: Support tickets show desktop visibility issues (3 emails reporting pet missing from desktop) and control confusion.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Compact Layout for Sign In Screen: Switch sign-in screen layout to compact to simplify the visual interface and display step progress. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with high mean duration (567s), indicating visual clutter or distraction.)
8: [home, wait_info] Pet Command Carousel on Waiting Screen: Add a auto-rotating tip carousel component to the waiting screen highlighting shortcut keys and desktop commands. (why: Wait info changes previously yielded a +5.0% boost, and support mailbox has multiple tickets about post-onboarding control confusion.)
